name: Scooch
title: Scooch moves your wallpaper out from under your icons
description: Scooch moves your own wallpaper so desktop icons stay off the best part of the picture. It works with any image on macOS, Windows and Linux.

beats.title: Wallpaper that scooches over for your icons.
Icons always land on the best part of the picture.
Scooch finds the subject with plain image math.
beats.support: No AI and no model files.

beats.title: Then it moves the picture so nothing important is covered.
Move an icon and the wallpaper follows.
Between changes it draws nothing.
beats.support: At rest it uses no CPU and about 7 MB of memory.

beats.title: It works with any picture on Mac, Windows and Linux.

facts: Works with the picture you already have.

alt: An old beige laptop open on a metal desk at night under an orange arm lamp. The screen shows a hot air balloon on a blue sky with desktop icons over it.
Close on the laptop screen, where desktop icons sit on the balloon.
The screen turns into a map of where the picture matters, glowing warm on the balloon over a dim grey copy of the photo.
The balloon photo after Scooch moved it, with every icon on open sky.
A pointer drags one icon onto the balloon, and after the drop the picture moves the balloon clear again.
The lamp is off and the laptop screen is the only light on the desk.
A wide shot of the desk with the lamp back on low.
